rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when someone or something is exposed to danger or risk.

example.english: That old building is compromised, so don't go near it.
example.traditional: 嗰座舊大廈仲有危險，唔好行埋去。
example.jyutping: go2 zo6 gau6 daai6 haa6 zung6 jau5 ngai4 him2 m4 hou2 haang4 maai4 heoi3

rows.note: Use this when the danger comes from a specific person, force, or threat.

example.english: The company's computer system is compromised by hackers, so the IT department disconnected it from the internet.
example.traditional: 公司嘅電腦系統受到黑客威脅，資訊科技部即刻斷網。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 ge3 din6 nou5 hai6 tung2 sau6 dou3 hak1 haak3 wai1 hip3 zi1 seon3 fo1 gei6 bou6 zik1 hak1 dyun6 mong5

rows.note: Use this when “compromised” means exposed to discredit or damage to one’s reputation.

example.english: After the scandal broke, his reputation was compromised, and even his friends distanced themselves from him.
example.traditional: 件醜聞一出，佢嘅名聲受損，連朋友都疏遠佢。
example.jyutping: gin6 cau2 man4 jat1 ceot1 keoi5 ge3 ming4 sing1 sau6 syun2 lin4 pang4 jau5 dou1 so1 jyun5 keoi5
